result.summary: PR #204 (STANDDOWN1) adds only the two files the brief owns: scripts/rules/StandDown.gd (81 lines) and tests/stand_down_test.gd (187 lines). Every function, constant, band edge and string matches the brief's steps 1 to 10. head_days() reads InjuryRoll.BOUT_TYPES' "head" row, so no knock days are typed in the module. The test has exactly 8 _check calls, one per letter a to h, and none of the brief's red checks were dropped or loosened (the 450..750 / 100..300 / 0 bars and the exact strings are kept). There are no fudge factors. The test can't pass on main because the preload is missing there. It calls the same static functions the later wiring will call, and no game path exists yet (wiring is Claude's follow-up). The dispatcher reports STAND_DOWN checks=8 failures=0 and INJURY_ROLL failures=0. Neither file, nor InjuryRoll.gd, changed on main since the merge base cc3937e7. REST1 (6fa2b52b) touched Attrs/rest, not these files, so the diff applies cleanly as two new files. The CI reds week_actual_test and guard_knee_test are unrelated: this PR touches nothing they read. Only small issues: the PR body leaves out the per-band knock counts and the exact line counts the brief asked for, and the module is 81 lines against "keep under ~80".

PR 206 (DUESWIRE1, Cursor) builds all five parts of the brief. There is a new 321-line scripts/ui/DuesWire.gd, plus small hooks in Home.gd (+4 lines), Money.gd (+34), WeekReview.gd (+4, now 494 lines), news wording in HomeJuniors.gd, a new tests/dues_wire_test.gd (315 lines) and a 66-line step in golden_path_test.gd. The pass chances come from Membership.intake_chance and no dues number was changed. dues_wire_test opens the real screens through Main.act and checks text, size (20 px or more), on-screen rects and overlaps, so it is not a test that can only pass. The dispatcher ran all 7 checks green.

None of the PR's files changed on main since the merge base 2abc263c. REST1 (6fa2b52b) and the other main commits touch none of them, so the diff applies cleanly to main today.

Problems to fix:
1. The new news line says the junior "is on trial", which is false. The junior goes in as a "scout" prospect, and the player still has to invite them (Roster.gd:86-92). The line also dropped the pointer to "Fighters > Find a fighter".
2. The failure line says "Came up through the youth section. Not this time." but names nobody, and nobody came up.
3. golden_path_test.gd grows from 547 to 613 lines. Main is already over the 500-line rule, and this makes it worse.
4. The golden step skips the game's own path. It moves time with `c.day += 7` plus GymSpend.end_week, adds cash and back-dates the youth section. It checks "the change in force" in the data only, never on the Money screen.

Smaller points:
- The hover names a "Club spending" screen that does not exist.
- The chance shown ignores the second-coach bonus.
- The Home row says "in 14 days" all week.
- "+N members" is a forecast, not the members actually gained.
- The card uses a flat gold border.
- The board numbers are stamped from outside DuesBoards by matching label text.

The Home row sits above the gym picture instead of in HomeNeeds. The seat's reason is that the needs board is below 1080; this is a visual check for Claude at collect. VISUAL: yes, so render Home in the preview week, Money's books, the dues boards and the intake week review before closing.
